mapper.sql: a.asset_id,a.public_id,s.public_id AS space_public_id,a.owner_id,a.media_type,a.original_filename, a.caption,a.taken_at,a.access_scope,a.library_visible,a.status AS asset_status, a.created_at AS asset_created_at,a.updated_at AS asset_updated_at, v.variant_type,v.profile,v.storage_provider,v.storage_key,v.content_type,v.size_bytes, v.checksum_sha256,v.width,v.height,v.duration_millis,v.status AS variant_status
a.deleted_at IS NULL AND a.status='READY' AND (a.owner_id=#{accountId} OR a.access_scope='SPACE' OR a.library_visible=true)
mapper.select: SELECT FROM media_asset a JOIN diary_space s ON s.space_id=a.space_id LEFT JOIN media_variant v ON v.asset_id=a.asset_id AND v.deleted_at IS NULL AND v.status='READY' WHERE a.space_id=#{spaceId} AND a.public_id=#{publicId} AND ORDER BY FIELD(v.variant_type,'THUMBNAIL','POSTER','ORIGINAL','TRANSCODED','WAVEFORM'),v.variant_id

SELECT FROM media_asset a JOIN diary_space s ON s.space_id=a.space_id LEFT JOIN media_variant v ON v.asset_id=a.asset_id AND v.deleted_at IS NULL AND v.status='READY' WHERE a.space_id=#{spaceId} AND AND a.public_id IN #{id} ORDER BY a.created_at DESC,a.asset_id DESC, FIELD(v.variant_type,'THUMBNAIL','POSTER','ORIGINAL','TRANSCODED','WAVEFORM'),v.variant_id

SELECT v.variant_type,v.profile,v.storage_provider,v.storage_key,v.content_type,v.size_bytes, v.checksum_sha256,v.width,v.height,v.duration_millis,v.status FROM media_asset a JOIN media_variant v ON v.asset_id=a.asset_id WHERE a.space_id=#{spaceId} AND a.public_id=#{publicId} AND AND v.variant_type=#{type} AND v.profile=#{profile} AND v.status='READY' AND v.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT v.variant_type,v.profile,v.storage_provider,v.storage_key,v.content_type,v.size_bytes, v.checksum_sha256,v.width,v.height,v.duration_millis,v.status FROM diary_space s JOIN media_asset a ON a.space_id=s.space_id JOIN media_variant v ON v.asset_id=a.asset_id WHERE s.public_id=#{spaceId} AND a.public_id=#{publicId} AND a.deleted_at IS NULL AND a.status='READY' AND v.variant_type=#{type} AND v.profile=#{profile} AND v.status='READY' AND v.deleted_at IS NULL
